acceptanceCriteria: An explicit record verb admits a reviewer verdict on a CEM citation as a secret-screened candidate observation.
Candidates reach ranking only through the existing held-out gate and are demoted when their cited blobs change or contrary verdicts accumulate.
body: Filed 2026-09-27 from the owner-requested gap analysis of Corvint against competing context tools, current standards and a trial on a local clone of MeVille (TypeScript, about 4,600 tracked files). Review products learn scoped rules from reactions and replies, promote them on positive signal and disable them when signal turns (Cursor Bugbot learned rules, reported resolution rate 52% to about 80%; Greptile; CodeRabbit Learnings; Qodo best practices). Corvint's learning is explicit, local and evaluation-gated (invariant 5); an explicit `record` of a reviewer's accepted or rejected CEM citation is a natural input, with demotion when cited blobs change or later reviews reject it. Related: V1-0217.
title: learning: capture reviewer feedback as candidate rules with promote and automatic demote under the evaluation gate
